_comment: One entry per manufacturing stage, in line order. 'work' is the effort one cylinder needs at that stage; an automated machine supplies 'base_rate' work per second per level. 'pos' is the station's position on the factory floor (pixels) and 'path_after' lists conveyor corner points on the way to the next station. 'milestones' double a machine's speed at the listed levels.

stations.name: Cutting
stations.desc: Shears copper sheet to size without a hand on the lever.

stations.name: Rolling
stations.desc: Motorised rollers curl each sheet into a tube.

stations.name: Welding
stations.desc: A robot arm brazes the seam and domes. Slow work - watch for queues here.

stations.name: Pressure Test
stations.desc: Clamps, fills and pressure-tests every cylinder automatically.

stations.name: Insulation
stations.desc: Sprays the classic green foam jacket.

stations.name: Packing
stations.desc: Boxes, tapes and labels cylinders ready for the van.
